description: This Java class implements a command strategy for fetching loan details by external ID within a batch processing system. It interacts with the LoansApiResource to retrieve loan information based on URL parameters extracted from batch requests, handling associated query parameters, error mapping, and batch response creation.

classes.name: GetLoanByExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy implementing retrieval of loan information by external ID from batch requests, using LoansApiResource and handling related URL and query parameter logic.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method executing the batch request to retrieve a loan by external ID, parsing URL parameters, invoking LoansApiResource, and constructing a BatchResponse.

methods.name: getQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts query parameters from a relative URL string into a Map.

methods.name: addQueryParametersToUriInfo
methods.description: Adds extracted query parameters to MutableUriInfo instance for downstream API call.
